question: Larger, substantially longer single-pass NAT Transformer versus optimized bidirectional Mamba-1; no diffusion or autoregressive feedback.
data: Full pinned WikiText-2 raw train split (10,951,562 bytes); uniform valid article-contained 128-byte windows, 96 prefix bytes + 32 fully blanked future bytes. Text-only primary training. Validation1024 windows spread over full official validation. Final full article-bounded WikiText test and a 100-document FineWeb-Edu cross-domain cohort, never used for tuning.
optimizer: AdamW, beta(.9,.999), eps1e-8, wd.01 for matrices except Mamba A_log, no decay1D; gradient clip1; 100-update warmup then cosine to10% over16000 steps. Both architectures use same schedule.
selection: Lowest final tuning validation suffix CE, independently for each architecture, all candidates retained; no test selection.
timing: Training CPU and wall time include forward, loss, backward, clipping and optimizer; exclude preparation/evaluation/save/compilation. First whole update crossing each CPU budget saved. End-to-end time and compiler overhead separate. Post-training standalone timing used for hardware comparison.
capability_protocol: Separate post-text-training equal-budget adaptation to unseen32-digit copy, reverse, sort and prefix cumulative sum modulo10. Balanced random tasks. 256 validation and1024 test inputs per task. Preserve text-only checkpoints; no general intelligence claim.
gpu: No GPU use: existing devices serve live training/services and expansion. No new rentals or paid resources.
safety: Scratch only; no live service changes, no production checkpoint conversion or deployment. Existing small baseline remains unchanged.
uncertainty: All three seeds, per-document paired bootstrap for held-out text conditional on fitted seeds, separate across-seed spread, no broad population/intelligence/600B claim.
limitations: Still a sub-million-parameter dense FP32 prototype, not exact AGILLM tokenizer/routing/quantization.
Single-pass conditional factorization with fixed output length32, not an EOS/length model.
CPU scan is now linear-work but is not official fused GPU Mamba-2.
Three seeds and bounded LR search do not establish optimum or convergence.
Training throughput under two isolated CPU jobs can differ from standalone hardware benchmarks; both are reported.
